summary: Kinross Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, attaching a press release providing an update on its Lobo-Marte project in Chile, a long-life, low-cost heap leach gold project. The update covers an initial ~15-year life with ~4.6 Moz. total production, ~350,000 oz./year average, ~$1,000/oz. AISC, $4.3 billion NPV, 26% IRR, and $1.8 billion initial capex. The filing is an operational project update on a development-stage asset, not a special situation. No terms, prices, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are present. The update is routine corporate reporting for a foreign private issuer, with no imminent transaction or structural event.
